# Original resources for actual ordinary scans and rendered callbacks

Head producer: 61d03cafff80e2c6e4d1348db4d79e2a6196fb2c.
Callback and head equations: 12aff46ab3e21c79f7e737d43cc024742b738a6d.
Receipt certificates: fde54e32af2df47c59c8f3b0a17ccf03bdaf3312.

## Strongest claim and new scope

H6, SourceCurrentColdFiniteWarmCalls.constructed_node_calls, remains the
strongest end-to-end language theorem. Covered closed construction and valid
constraint-allocation history supply any prescribed finite number of modeled
node-processing rounds. Derived sufficient fuel and one mathematical integer
width chosen after construction give an actual finite trace. Its inherited
payload is empty. The final available value has exactly the original finite-
tree language for every ambient context and term under formal Formula and
Entailment semantics. Arbitrary mixed calls and full recursive enumeration
remain outside H6.

The new producer derives the actual ordinary entry and complete ordered
alternative observation with concrete rendered callbacks. It uses current
Packet, ordinary parent decode, selected-edge membership, IncomingAvoid,
Fits, one original mixed reservation and its guard carrier. A sufficient
common work fuel derives exact execution at every larger bound. Future
callback success, range admission and subtree endpoints are not inputs.

The callback's restart uses zero recursive fuel. Callback pruning and stuck
return no outputs. Stop returns the actual updated metadata and framed cache.
Done returns None metadata with its actual framed cache. Expansion returns an
explicit exhausted stop at the same native caller. This theorem does not
execute a deeper selected expansion. Supported edges can still exhaust.
It therefore makes no supported-implies-complete claim for this hooked scan.

## Run each head and callback at the actual native endpoint

NativeBranchCompletion.head_complete_resources is now public. Its complete
type and proof are unchanged. One comment and the privacy modifier are the
only edits in that existing module. No existing public output is weakened.

NativeContinuations.continued_head relates an actual head result and its
actual continuation to the suffix. It handles both completed fragments and
literal rejection continuations. The suffix starts at the hook's actual
returned caller and query state. The result retains receipt order and output
concatenation. This is an execution equation. It adds no runtime definition.

Recursive.callback_zero_complete_resources calls callback_complete ONCE.
It retains the entire earlier callback output: returned Packet, RenderStable,
Frame, all metadata equations, stable Success, exact singleton raw and the
generic continuation equation for every recur, stop and order. It adds a
fixed actual HookResult for all larger callback and work fuels. The complete
observer retains each output's callback-cache Packet and metadata equation.
The exhausted observer retains the exact selected variable, updated metadata,
framed cache and native endpoint. Native resources stay at the original
callback caller. No Safe fact is inferred from Frame alone.

receipt_zero_complete derives the callback packet from a genuine completed
head's Admitted, Pending and FragmentHistory facts. IncomingAvoid and the
original Packet supply the required reference and metadata bounds. It uses
the head Post's actual full memo state. A rejected head does not run the
callback and has the literal empty-output continuation. The helper derives
one stable outcome. It assumes no successful future callback.

## Keep receipt, output and stopped-current certificates separate

ReceiptAt retains Admitted, Pending, FragmentHistory, actual advance endpoint,
full Post memos, saved query equality and Fits/carrier at:

    advance seed (cost scs originalCounter (selectedEdges.take(index+1)))

Admitted gives Safe only for a completed fragment. Rejection receives no Safe
packet. The next sibling restores the original captured cache, whose Packet
is preserved by the actual head Post.

OutputAt keeps each emitted output at its own native caller and callback
cache. It retains a full memo witness, original-caller-to-output Post, exact
query equality and Packet. A None metadata output retains the actual updated
metadata as an existential Packet witness. It is not retargeted to the final
scan caller. Its resource bound uses its own original selected-edge prefix.

StoppedAt distinguishes unsupported edge from exhausted callback. An
unsupported projection has the exact edge stop with no encoded endpoint.
An exhausted callback retains its current completed receipt inside
continuation, outside processed. It supplies ReceiptAt at processed.length,
the exact exhausted metadata/cache and Packet at the final full memo state.
The resource cost includes this current edge. The producer keeps a separate
aggregate final Post, captured Packet and padded final Fits/carrier.

The prepend lemmas compose original Posts and shift each suffix certificate
to its original edge prefix. Full memos remain explicit. Query equality does
not identify complete memo states.

## Derive the actual scan from the original reservation

alternatives_zero_complete_resources inducts over the actual selected edge
list. Each reached head uses head_complete_resources once. Each completed
fragment uses receipt_zero_complete once. The captured enumeration cache and
metadata stay fixed across siblings. The actual native caller and full memos
pass from the head to the hook and then to the suffix.

The original reservation splits at each head cost. Its cost includes actual
projected child buckets, duplicates, native queries and optional enabled Empty
allocation. Callback and zero-fuel restart retain the native caller, so they
need no additional native query step. Arity rejection and valid raw-empty
rejection retain their actual advance endpoint and continue through the same
induction. Unsupported projection and exhausted hook stop before the suffix.
Unused suffix forecasts pad bounds without asserting execution.

The main result retains exact stable worker equality, full final Post,
captured Packet, final Fits/carrier, every indexed receipt certificate, every
emitted output certificate, and exact complete/unsupported/exhausted shape.
Earlier shallow scan receipts do not identify later hooked receipts. The
proof constructs each actual reached head directly. It uses no identity hook.

ordinary_zero_complete_resources calls SelectedEntry.complete ONCE. It derives
its actual entered Packet with RenderStable.safe, pending_read, stratified_read
and unchanged counter. Entry changes ancestry. The proof does not assert a
compression Frame. Equality of the attached cache's constructor fields is
used only to identify the wrapper's actual captured cache.

The wrapper calls the new scan producer ONCE at that entered cache. Its
counter equals the original counter, so the original reservation applies.
The result retains the ENTIRE main output, with receipt/output/stop
certificates based on the actual entered cache. It adds exact entry and
ordinary-wrapper observations, stable entry counters/values/indexes and the
entered Packet. Entry fuel plus scan fuel gives one common larger-fuel bound.

## Validation and preserved sources

All eight changed modules, including the existing head module and Audit, pass
strict warningAsError and linter.all checks. Aggregate Audit passes 3831 jobs
and checks 77360 theorem dependencies. Installed public readback checks 14
declarations and prints 13 full definitions. Its 1479 lines contain 103612
bytes. SHA256: a9c42fcae266317968fae9ad031752a72fff6bf5043a04cd5e5c27619d5aa380.
Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound appear in the axiom reports.

Exact contract checks retain all eight main output clauses in the ordinary
wrapper, after its explicit edge/cache specialization and counter equality.
They retain all six original callback facts and all three uniform callback
facts, including the generic continuation equation. The normalized full main
packet contains 1313 characters. The callback packet contains 887 characters.
These source-text checks supplement the kernel checks. They are not proof
of source correspondence or a substitute for checking actual execution.

The first callback check found a missing namespace and a shadowed variable.
The first generic head-equation check required explicit suffix case analysis.
The first scan check found notation, dependent-match and fuel-rewrite issues.
The second left one dependent-match application. Explicit receipt case
analysis fixed it. The third scan check passes. The callback was then
strengthened to retain the earlier generic continuation equation. Its receipt
consumer was checked after the projection changed. The final dependent build
checks that the unchanged scan and wrapper consume that stronger interface.
All failed and successful source snapshots and raw reports remain in evidence.
No initial premise or claimed conclusion was weakened to resolve these errors.
Independent final source reviews are clear for callbacks, certificates,
actual scan, receipt consumer and ordinary entry.

All heavy checks ran serially under a 4 GiB cap. Every report reads effective
memory.max=memory.high=4294967296 and memory.swap.max=0. Existing unused-input
warnings from an unchanged dependency remain in aggregate build output.
The only existing source edits are the public head theorem and one Audit
import. Runtime workers, older public APIs and H6 remain unchanged. Haskell
source remains unchanged. No Haskell tests or formatters were needed.
FINDINGS keeps all six merged Haskell repairs and the pending Sized
documentation repair af6369a9e. No new runtime defect or repair is claimed.

## Next original forecast for recursive expansion

Compose the actual selected prefix and this actual ordinary-entry producer.
The initial prefix theorem already pays its cold row read and filtered node
rebuild. The ordinary scan's exact edge cost currently uses its current
captured node and suspended inputs. For a complete selected expansion, bound
those counts from the original packet, numeric profile and guard alphabet
before narrowing allocates its returned caller.

Then reserve complete deeper recursive subtrees before later siblings. Each
sibling must use the actual post-subtree caller and full memos. Keep original
captured cache and sibling metadata, each output's own Post and a separate
final native Post. Keep exhaustion and unsupported observations explicit.
Do not use PrefixValid.finish as an executed ordinary scan.

The existing reserved_computed theorem chooses a sufficient mathematical
width from an original finite schedule. It does not convert an existing
caller to that width, establish host-64 capacity or bound practical runtime.
Whole recursive capacity, whole-driver language, terminal outer fallback,
native Graph correspondence, concrete solver and physical-container
correspondence, machine integers, extraction, convergence and arbitrary lazy
forcing remain open. No completion percentage is established.
